source.source_title: Contemporary Science Issues and Innovations: Mushrooms and Fungi: Their Role in Nature 10/05/17
source.why_this_clip: One continuous close shot from a low angle of a single mushroom cap seen from the side and below, its gills lit from behind against a blue sky. There are no cuts in the clip and the mushroom does not move; only the light on the gills shifts slightly, so this middle interval is as good as any other.
